card.name: Kochari
card.era: Ancient; over 1,000 years of attested practice
card.tagline: Ancient ram-leaping circle dance of shared identity
card.profile: Kochari (Քոչարի) is a traditional Armenian group folk dance from the Armenian highlands, performed in lines or semicircles with dancers holding hands or shoulders, featuring energetic knee bends and leaps that imitate horned animals; in Armenian the name means roughly "knee-come" (Wikipedia; UNESCO). It is danced by men and women of all ages to zurna and dhol, with a tempo ranging from moderate to fast and a lead dancer signalling figure changes.
card.insight: Kochari was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity on December 6, 2017 (decision 12.COM 11.b.2, Jeju, South Korea); UNESCO notes it "provides a sense of shared identity and solidarity" and is "one of the rare traditional dances whose chain of transmission has never been interrupted."

observation.setting: Outdoors in multiple scenic locations including a mountain cliff edge, grassy area near ancient stone fortress walls, paved courtyard of a large white church, and a sculpture garden
observation.dancers: A group of adult men (around 10-12 dancers)
observation.formation_and_space: A single straight line or curved line moving together, sometimes forming a circle or crescent; stepping side-to-side and traveling across various outdoor terrains
observation.posture: Upright and proud torso, knees flexing and lifting with weight distributed between steps
observation.footwork: Stepping side to side, hopping on one foot while lifting the other leg high with bent knees, stamping on beats, and occasional kicks or knee lifts
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held out to the sides with hands linked/joined with neighbors, or shoulders-to-shoulders hold; one dancer at the end occasionally waving a red flag
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains relatively stable and upright with occasional forward bends or synchronized leans
observation.partnering: Group line hold where dancers hold hands or place hands on each other's shoulders in a chain formation
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent hopping and jumping movements on beats, maintaining a low-to-medium level with springy knee action
observation.costume_and_props: Two sets of costumes: one group in traditional dark red and patterned folk tunics with fur accents, another group in military camouflage uniforms; one red flag held by a dancer
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement granularity during fast group movements due to rapid camera cuts and varying aerial angles
